preprocessing: Pillow RGB conversion, bilinear resize from 2560x1440 to 960x540 preserving aspect ratio, float32 /255, NCHW. Author unnormalized 0..1 RGB contract, evaluation resize declared separately. IAT(type='exp'), eval mode, strict weights_only checkpoint load. No architectural changes initially.
timing: Game, Workbench and companion stopped. Verify RX 7800 XT adapter 0, DirectML FP32 with CPU execution fallback disabled. First view five warmups and twenty synchronized calls; remaining views one warmup and five calls. Retain every call and CPU reference timing. Model calls include input upload and output readback; decode, resize, protected composition and file encoding excluded. No application-FPS claim.

parity.scope: Independent unchanged-author CPU outputs versus DirectML for all three returned tensors (mul, add, enhanced) on every selected view.

protected_version: One fixed diagnostic at original 2560x1440: form author enhanced minus its 960x540 input, bilinear resize this residual to source dimensions, clamp each RGB residual to [-0.08,0.08], multiply by 0.5 and a source-luminance guard smoothstep(0.02,0.08,Y)*(1-smoothstep(0.85,0.98,Y)). Set weight zero in top/bottom 8% HUD margins and a central 5%-wide/high crosshair square. Nonfinite residual pixels fall back to source. Clamp final RGB to 0..1; retain pre-clamp values and report newly clipped channels. No tuning or alternate strengths.
review: Inspect native sources, complete raw outputs and protected native-size images for both selection views before the reserved view. Freeze selection decision before opening reserved results. Check signs, facade openings, fence/pole edges, foliage gaps, roof color/texture, local halos and shade detail. Report author output clipping; internal author color clamp is part of the model, not removed for evaluation.
acceptance: Require meaningful improvement in material or lighting appearance while preserving source identity, detail and visibility. A brightness/color change alone is insufficient. No aligned photographic ground truth is available. Failed cost, parity, fidelity or appearance closes live integration with all code/output retained. An accepted static candidate still needs separate motion/HUD and complete-application performance/latency evaluation. No training or package change in this experiment.
